blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, CEBU, PHILIPPINES — From five-star hospitality to MICHELIN Guide recognitions, Sheraton Cebu Mactan Resort, part of Marriott International’s global portfolio of hotel brands, continues to distinguish itself in Cebu’s hospitality and dining scene. The resort retained its MICHELIN Selected hotel status in 2026, following its inaugural selection in 2025, while its signature restaurant, DIP Nikkei, earned MICHELIN Guide recognition in both 2026 and 2027. Further affirming its standing, the resort received a five-star rating from the Department of Tourism (DOT) in May 2026, reinforcing its position as a destination for distinctive stays and culinary discovery in Mactan.
